description: The user’s pronunciation dictionary (word → how to say it, e.g. {"melhor":"mêlhor"}), applied automatically to every Studio render and to the site’s Test voice. Without `entradas` it shows the dictionary; with `entradas` it REPLACES it (read it first and send the whole map). Ask the user which words come out wrong; let them hear it on the site (My Models › Test voice › Pronunciation). Free.

entradas.description: Whole dictionary {"word":"spoken form"} (max 200). Omit to read.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

name: studio_pronuncia
title: Studio: pronunciation dictionary
